name: Monastic Island of Reichenau
description: Reichenau is a small island in Lake Constance, in southern Germany, about 4.5 km long and reached by a causeway from the mainland. A Benedictine monastery founded here in 724 became a powerful centre of learning and art. Three churches, mostly built between the 9th and 11th centuries, still stand, and their early medieval wall paintings are among the island's great treasures.
